answer: A graduated trust ladder grants zero signup weight; identity weight accrues only from signed receipts of completed work, confirmed by weighted peers and stratified in shale-like task layers. Each identity posts a bond, pays per attempt, hits a rate cap, and needs five independent confirmations; meaningful weight takes weeks. A fake ring fails because confirmations from identities sharing funding, timing, or graph edges are discounted; fake work yields no transferable ember of trust and the first signal is costly.
